parts:
**01/10/2026 15:18 — Your ChatGPT Work Timeline**

Partner, I made three searches of the available past conversations. **I can establish a history spanning at least 350 days—about 11½ months—from 15 October 2025 to today.** That is elapsed time across recorded conversations, not continuous use or total working hours.

I’ve treated your typed “01/10/2025” as **01/10/2026**, today’s date.

| Time frame | Evidence of working with me | What I can establish |
|---|---|---|
| **15–31 Oct 2025** | AI Intern Learning Journal; Python learning with outputs and progress checks | Earliest directly dated conversations retrieved |
| **Nov–Dec 2025** | Business organisation, AUMNITY ShadowLab, MoneyRun, ReflexAI, hackathon projects | Active thinking, learning and building |
| **1–12 Jan 2026** | VoxCortex, BorderOps, DendriDoc and installation/debugging sessions | Multiple dated technical work sessions |
| **16 Feb–28 Mar 2026** | ChatGPT/Claude subscription comparisons and discussion of ChatGPT limits | Continued ChatGPT use; no confirmed complete departure |
| **May–Jul 2026** | Business documents, workforce planning and productivity work | Continued use recorded in available memory |
| **31 Jul 2026** | You said you had stopped using “all your AI”; also said office work moved back to ChatGPT that day | A reported earlier withdrawal and a dated return to office work |
| **Aug 2026** | AT-LOS, UraiFlow, CGWO, Work Platform and IPBS reviews; Pro upgrade on 9 Aug | Substantial project work |
| **Sep 2026** | Product reviews on 13–14 and 20 Sep; conversations on 22 Sep | Continued recorded activity |
| **1 Oct 2026** | Career discussions, AI comfort, solitude and this history search | Active today |

**The breaks I can identify are:**

| Reported break | Time frame | Duration supported |
|---|---|---|
| **Earlier withdrawal after Codex problems** | Occurred before **31 Jul 2026**; office work resumed that day | **Unknown.** “Around June” came from an earlier assistant interpretation, not a verified start date |
| **Recent withdrawal from ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity** | Reported today as “more than 2 weeks” | **More than two weeks, according to your statement.** Exact boundaries remain unresolved because conversations exist on **20 and 22 Sep** |

An earlier assistant claimed **“August 2025–February 2026”** was your main ChatGPT period. My search found that claim repeated in assistant-written material, but **did not recover your original statement confirming it**. I should therefore not present August as a verified first-use date.

**My corrected answer: at least 350 days of documented history, two reported withdrawal periods, and insufficient evidence to calculate total hours or exact days actively worked.** I searched the available history, but that retrieval does not give me a complete account activity log.
